title: Red panda dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='28' ry='4' fill='#3a2a1a' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M68 70 Q82 60 84 45 Q86 35 78 34 Q72 33 72 42 Q72 55 62 64 Z' fill='#c44a1a'/>
  <path d='M79 37 Q82 40 81 46 Q79 52 76 52' stroke='#e8863a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M74 42 Q76 46 73 50' stroke='#e8863a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- left leg -->
  <rect x='32' y='76' width='10' height='14' rx='4' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='90' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#1a1008'/>

  <!-- right leg (raised, dancing) -->
  <path d='M58 76 Q64 72 68 76 L70 86 Q68 90 62 89 Z' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#1a1008'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#c44a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='67' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#e8683a' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- left arm waving -->
  <path d='M29 58 Q18 48 14 38 Q12 33 17 32 Q22 31 24 38 Q27 47 33 54 Z' fill='#c44a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='17' cy='33' rx='5' ry='5' fill='#2a1a10'/>

  <!-- right arm out -->
  <path d='M71 58 Q82 54 88 48 Q91 45 88 41 Q84 38 81 43 Q77 49 69 53 Z' fill='#c44a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='87' cy='42' rx='5' ry='5' fill='#2a1a10'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='21' ry='18' fill='#e05a20'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M33 18 Q29 6 36 10 Q42 14 40 20 Z' fill='#e05a20'/>
  <path d='M34 17 Q32 11 36 12 Q39 14 38 18 Z' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <path d='M67 18 Q71 6 64 10 Q58 14 60 20 Z' fill='#e05a20'/>
  <path d='M66 17 Q68 11 64 12 Q61 14 62 18 Z' fill='#2a1a10'/>

  <!-- white face markings -->
  <path d='M50 34 Q38 28 34 36 Q32 44 42 46 Q48 46 50 40 Z' fill='#f5ede0'/>
  <path d='M50 34 Q62 28 66 36 Q68 44 58 46 Q52 46 50 40 Z' fill='#f5ede0'/>
  <path d='M42 46 Q50 52 58 46 Q54 58 50 58 Q46 58 42 46 Z' fill='#f5ede0'/>

  <!-- dark eye patches -->
  <path d='M44 36 Q38 32 35 37 Q33 42 39 44 Q44 44 45 39 Z' fill='#3a1a10'/>
  <path d='M56 36 Q62 32 65 37 Q67 42 61 44 Q56 44 55 39 Z' fill='#3a1a10'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='3.2' fill='#1a0a04'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='38' r='3.2' fill='#1a0a04'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#1a0a04'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#6a3a2a'/>

  <!-- mouth smiling -->
  <path d='M45 51 Q50 56 55 51' stroke='#1a0a04' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='46' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#f07878' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='46' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#f07878' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- dance sparkles -->
  <path d='M22 64 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M80 68 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
